blocks.x: Clinicians get 90 minutes a day back — ambient documentation inside the EHR
A 12-hospital US health system — Healthcare & Life Sciences engagement delivered by a 18-person team over 11 months, US scope, commercial model: build-transfer.

items: Physicians documented 3+ hours daily; burnout metrics deteriorating across specialties.
Prior AI tools stalled at EHR integration and compliance review.
PHI estate faced ransomware exposure from legacy devices and vendor access.

blocks.x: We deployed ambient documentation integrated into the EHR with clinician sign-off, grounded on specialty-specific note templates and governed by the clinical AI board on Compass (model cards, evaluations, oversight gates). A parallel security program segmented medical devices and rehearsed clinical-continuity recovery — including a manual-fallback drill per department.

The program ran through the Achala Method: a Value Mapping Sprint locked the baseline, a gated PoC produced the capital-grade evidence, and production hardening (replay, SLOs, control tests) was generated by the delivery itself rather than reconstructed for audit.

items: Fresh waste down 28%, OOS down 31% — day-part demand and ordering agents
Fraud and error capture up 26% — cross-source analytics with investigator case packs

blocks.x: Towers: Applied AI & Generative AI, Data, Analytics & Lakehouse, Cybersecurity & Zero-Trust. Platforms: Achala Forge, Achala Compass.

blocks.caption: Measured outcomes
rows: proven at 4 hours for EHR read-only

items: the decision/data architecture pattern, the control matrix and the run model — adapted per estate in weeks, not quarters.
organizational absorption: adoption paths are designed for each client's operating culture, never assumed.
